parts.name: Rotation Blade
parts.Basic_description: The rotation blade is the sharp cutting component of the knife, made of stainless steel for durability and sharpness.
parts.Functional_description: It performs the cutting action by slicing through materials when force is applied. It can rotate or fold into the handle for safety.
parts.Movement_description: It can rotate or pivot around a hinge point to fold into or extend from the base body.

parts.name: Base Body
parts.Basic_description: The base body is the handle of the knife, typically made of durable plastic with ergonomic grooves for grip.
parts.Functional_description: It provides a comfortable and secure grip for the user, housing the pivot mechanism for the blade.
parts.Movement_description: It remains stationary during use, serving as the main support structure for the rotating blade.
